Subject: Quick walk-through request — Quantica report download

Hi Tom —

Thanks for downloading the benchmark report earlier today. I’m Priyom on the SDR team at Redwood. I reviewed the report you pulled and it looks like there are some interesting signal patterns around latency sensitivity and cost per token that would map well to a short product walk. Would you be open to a 30-minute live demo to run through:

- The benchmark findings in your report (we can confirm runtime assumptions)
- How Redwood’s routing + caching could reduce your steady-state token cost
- A short technical look at latency numbers on similar workloads

If that works, here are a couple quick options I have for the next 3 business days (all times Pacific):
- Wed May 6, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed May 6, 15:00–15:30 PT
- Thu May 7, 09:00–09:30 PT

You can also pick any slot directly on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/s/priyom/30

I’ve attached the version of your downloaded report with a few annotated highlights (quantica_benchmark_report.pdf). If you’d like the walk to focus on procurement/security concerns instead of raw performance, let me know and I’ll bring a solutions engineer.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
SDR | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

Wed May 6 at 15:00 PT works for us — just confirming that is 18:00 our time (we’re in ET). Can you add Ida (ida@quantica.io) to the invite?

Also, can you add a short agenda so we can route any pre-call questions to our security team?

Thanks,
